atoms.1: Losartan is an angiotensin II receptor antagonist.
atoms.2: Losartan is used to treat high blood pressure.
atoms.3: Losartan is used to treat certain types of kidney disease.
atoms.4: The recommended dosage of losartan is typically 50-100 mg once daily.
atoms.5: Taking two pills of losartan at once is not recommended.
atoms.6: Taking two pills of losartan at once may increase the risk of adverse effects.
atoms.7: Taking two pills of losartan at once does not provide additional benefits.
atoms.8: It is best to take losartan at the same time every day.
atoms.9: You should take losartan as directed by your healthcare provider.

snippets.output: Losartan is an angiotensin II receptor antagonist used to treat high blood pressure and certain types of kidney disease.
The recommended dosage of losartan is typically 50-100 mg once daily.
Taking two pills of losartan at once is not recommended as it may increase the risk of adverse effects and does not provide additional benefits.
It is best to take losartan at the same time every day, as directed by your healthcare provider.
